sources.title: Mistral 7B public release announcement
sources.evidence: Dated September 27, 2023 and explicitly announces release with public downloads under Apache 2.0. Calls the original model 7.3B parameters, describes GQA and sliding-window attention, and distinguishes the base model from the accompanying chat fine-tune.

sources.title: Mistral 7B v0.1 official model documentation
sources.evidence: The version 0.1 Base Weights row links this exact checkpoint and separately lists Parameters (B)=7, Active (B)=7, Apache 2.0 and 8k context. This is nominal documentation precision; the hosted model is marked retired.

sources.title: Mistral 7B v0.1 official documentation Markdown
sources.evidence: Fetched successfully by HTTPS despite the web reader failing on this Markdown URL. Explicitly lists release date 2023-09-27, version 0.1, text input/output, open weights, Apache 2.0 and 8k context, linking the exact base checkpoint.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact pretrained generative text checkpoint, the Mistral AI team, Apache-2.0 license and nominal 7B size. Describes a Transformer with grouped-query and sliding-window attention and distinguishes it as a base model. No dedicated reasoning mode or native tool-calling support is documented.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM; 32 layers; hidden size 4096; intermediate size 14336; 32 query heads and 8 KV heads; vocabulary 32000; untied embeddings; BF16; SiLU; sliding_window 4096. max_position_embeddings is 32768, a configuration value distinct from the paper's context_len 8192.

sources.title: Mistral 7B technical report, version 1
sources.evidence: Table 1 gives context_len 8192 and window_size 4096 with the exact 32-layer, 4096-width, 14336-MLP, 32-query/8-KV-head, 32000-vocabulary architecture. Describes autoregressive Transformer attention and distinguishes pretrained Mistral 7B from instruction fine-tuning. Reasoning benchmark results do not establish a dedicated reasoning training mode.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 full Safetensors checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps 291 distinct tensors to two shards and declares 14,483,464,192 tensor-data bytes. Every indexed tensor name and shard assignment was matched to the bounded shard headers; the complete learned-tensor shapes also match the configuration.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 model-00001-of-00002.safetensors header
sources.evidence: Validated HTTP 206 reads of the 8-byte prefix and 23,608-byte JSON header only. Contains 203 BF16 learned weight tensors totaling 4,971,479,040 elements. Shape products match contiguous offsets, all index assignments, and the 9,942,981,696-byte file size. No buffers or quantization scales appear.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 model-00002-of-00002.safetensors header
sources.evidence: Validated HTTP 206 reads of the 8-byte prefix and 10,224-byte JSON header only. Contains 88 BF16 learned weight tensors totaling 2,270,253,056 elements. Shape products match contiguous offsets, all index assignments, and the 4,540,516,344-byte file size. No buffers or quantization scales appear.

sources.title: Original September 27, 2023 Mistral reference implementation
sources.evidence: The release-day code implements every Transformer block using four bias-free attention projections, one three-matrix SiLU-gated dense feed-forward module and two learned RMSNorm weights. Separate input/output matrices and final RMSNorm account for the remaining tensors. Rotary frequencies are computed separately; there is no expert routing.

sources.title: Mistral-7B-v0.1 tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Contains the text tokenizer settings with unknown/BOS/EOS tokens and no chat template or tools/reasoning serialization. This omission does not prove lack of a capability; neither Boolean capability is inferred from it.

name.note: Normalizes spaces in the exact published checkpoint name.

developer.note: The release announcement and official repository identify the Mistral AI team.

family.note: The exact checkpoint belongs to Mistral 7B and declares model_type mistral.

release_date.note: An explicit dated public release announcement supports day precision; the later October technical report is not the release date.

open_weights.note: The release supplies public weights, and both official checkpoint shard headers were accessible. Retirement of hosting does not withdraw those weights.

license.note: Apache 2.0 is explicitly stated in the announcement and the exact checkpoint card.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete checkpoint count: 7,241,732,096 learned parameters / 1e9, summed from all 291 BF16 tensor shapes. Includes separate 32000-by-4096 input/output matrices, all 32 attention/MLP blocks and learned norms. All names, shapes, shard assignments, byte offsets and data totals were validated; no scales or buffers were counted. The announcement's 7.3B and model card's 7B are nominal labels, not this exact count.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact Base Weights row explicitly labels Active (B)=7. Preserve that nominal source precision; no exact active count is derived by equating dense total and active parameters.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with GQA and a 4096-token attention window. Original code and all checkpoint tensors have one dense gated MLP per layer and no MoE experts or routers.

context_window.note: Retain the paper's explicit context_len=8192, corroborated by official 8k documentation. HF max_position_embeddings=32768 and theoretical attention reach describe different limits and do not replace the documented context.

modalities.note: Explicit text input and text output in official documentation, consistent with the pretrained generative text checkpoint.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode or reasoning-specific training is disclosed for this exact base checkpoint in the reviewed primary sources. General reasoning benchmark results and tokenizer omissions do not justify true or false.

tool_call.note: The reviewed exact base-model documentation does not disclose native tool/function calling. No Boolean is inferred from absence of a chat template or from later Mistral variants.

description.note: The original announcement and exact model card support this concise description; it makes no unsupported capability claim.

patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint: 7,241,732,096 learned parameters (7.241732096B), verified across all 291 indexed tensors. Official v0.1 documentation separately reports nominal Active (B)=7; this is not an exact active count. The release announcement uses the nominal 7.3B label. Context is the documented 8192 tokens; HF max_position_embeddings=32768 is a distinct configuration limit. Dedicated reasoning and native tool calling are not disclosed for this base checkpoint.

sources.label: Official v0.1 base-model specifications and nominal active count

summary: Replaces the nominal 7.3B total with the exact 7.241732096B learned checkpoint count and adds the separately documented nominal 7B active count. Confirms the September 27, 2023 public release, open Apache-2.0 weights, dense text Transformer and 8192-token documented context. Resolves the 32768 configuration/context distinction explicitly. Reasoning and native tool calling remain null because reviewed primary sources do not disclose those capabilities.
